description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various emotions, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct emotion. The slices are labeled as Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Neutral (dark blue, 23.1%), Anger (yellow, 14.9%), Excitement (red, 14.1%), Sadness (orange, approximately 14%), and Happiness (pink, 8.1%). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice (Frustration) positioned at the top left and the smallest slice (Happiness) at the bottom right. The segments appear to be ordered by size, with the larger slices preceding the smaller ones in a clockwise direction.
